critique.reason: Customer Emeka Okafor conducted 3 cash deposits totaling N5,500,000.00 within 25.5 hours. Mathematical aggregation proves structuring to evade statutory individual limit of N5,000,000 under CBN AML/CFT Regulations 2022 Section 10(3).

synthesis.summary: Investigation into transaction TX-NGA-2023-0101 established intentional structuring of multiple cash deposits below N5,000,000 aggregating to N5,500,000 within 25.5 hours, violating CBN Sec 10(3).
synthesis.recommended_action: File Suspicious Transaction Report (STR) with NFIU within 24 hours.
